note: cli/tests/heavy_tier.rs the_untokenised_ignore_reasons_are_exactly_this_roster IS BLIND TO MULTI-LINE IGNORE REASONS. Its scanner splits on the ignore-attribute opener and then on the closing quote-bracket WITHIN THE SAME LINE, so any #[ignore = ...] whose reason wraps across lines with backslash continuations is never captured: the roster count does not move and the ignore is never a reviewed decision. Verified 2026-08-13 during The Gnomon by emulating the scanner against a new ten-line reason -- roster stayed at 29, the new ignore printed as NOT CAPTURED. SEVEN PRE-EXISTING IGNORES ESCAPE THE SAME WAY, so the roster understates real deferrals. Keep ignore reasons on ONE line if you want the ratchet to see them. Related: preregistration_guard.rs only scans windows/lab/tests/*calibration*.rs, so an ignore in src/ is outside both.
